questions.question: Check Cantor’s dates and role in the German Mathematical Society, priority claims and historical generalizations.

localizations.source: Check Cantor’s dates and role in the German Mathematical Society, priority claims and historical generalizations.
localizations.ru: Проверить даты и роль Кантора в Германском математическом обществе, приоритеты и исторические обобщения.

questions.resolution: Priority and causal claims were qualified: Cantor’s role in the congress is described without sole priority, disputed attributions were removed, and the reception of set theory and foundational schools is presented without a rigid causal chain.
